ValidationRule.description: Stage gate: Retailer acquisition, Account opened and later stages need Amount and Close date.
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND(RecordType.DeveloperName = "Retailer_acquisition", CASE(StageName, "Identified", 1, "Contacted", 2, "Line sheet sent", 3, "Range review", 4, "Terms discussion", 5, "Account setup", 6, "Account opened", 7, 0) >= 7, OR(ISBLANK(Amount), ISBLANK(CloseDate)))
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Fill in Amount and Close date before moving to Account opened.
